concerns.title: Dennis Easley — JERA Upstream, Evans 34-3, rig up, 5:52 PM, job 35184: loud alarms and lights recorded as not tested at rig up. The checklist question was answered No, an
concerns.text: "Loud Alarms and Lights Tested?: No" "Talked with company man and light plant power source for monitor was being delivered, he said he would power up and place monitor" This is outside the lights-and-sirens exemption Kelby Hammer confirmed on 09/23, which covers the shift-change question on the H2S daily only. One form is not the mis-selection pattern and should be looked at separately. Ruben Rojo, XTO, Adams W E 23-26 4405H, air job, 11:58 AM, job 35042_1: the observe multi-select is empty, the what-went-well multi-select is empty, and the entire Learn section including the location name is blank. The only narrative is "Job was canceled, reason not given". There is no positive narrative to offset the blank close-out, which is the same shape as his 09/23/2026 entry ("Job was suspended reason not given by MT"). This is a recurrence and is worth asking him about directly rather than treating as a selection error. Compounding it, the board shows Adams W E as an active assignment and shows Powell 34 3 as CANCELLED, while Rojo filed a form for Powell 34 3 at 7:37 AM saying "Job was canceled due to poor road conditions" and reported Adams W E as the cancelled one. SCBA was utilized during atmospheric testing at the initial first break...") on Wilde Garner 14WE 5H and 14WD 4H. Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based, so a defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside images, not as text, and were not read.

A second limitation applies to this run specifically. The review runs at 11:00 PM Central, so the usual follow-up search over the next morning's mail could not be performed — submissions for 09/30 that land after midnight Central are not included here. Anything reported above as not received should be read as not received as of 11:00 PM on 09/30.
